name: Positive User
summary: Marketing automation platform from the French Positive group, formerly User.com: email, SMS and WhatsApp campaigns, real-time visitor tracking, website personalisation and workflows, hosted in Europe.
best_for: European small and mid-sized businesses that want email, SMS, WhatsApp and website behaviour tracking in one EU-hosted platform, with a modest sending volume and a small marketing team
skip_if: you send large newsletters every week, you want month-to-month billing printed up front, or you only need a newsletter tool and not the automation and tracking layer
honest_knock: Every Marketing Suite plan stops at 60,000 emails a year, about 5,000 a month, and the next step up is the Performance plan at €999 a month with 300,000 emails a month (pricing page, 13 November 2026), so a weekly newsletter to a few thousand contacts outgrows even the €499 plan. Until 13 November the page printed only annual prices (on 18 November it added a Monthly toggle at €89, €239 and €599 a month), seats beyond the included one or two cost €69 to €199 a month each, and auto-renewal is on by default: stopping an annual plan takes notice to your account manager at least 30 days ahead, with no refund for the rest of the term. The 7-day trial is short for an automation platform.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Campaigns · per month billed annually, 1 seat included
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-07 on user.com/pricing in a browser render, prices in EUR as the page prints them, billed annually; re-verified 2026-11-13 with a plain fetch) Positive User, the platform formerly called User.com and now part of the French Positive group, sells a Marketing Suite in three plans. Campaigns is €69 a month billed annually with 1 seat: email, SMS and WhatsApp marketing, the drag-and-drop editor, a library of ready-made workflows, unlimited contacts, up to 60,000 emails a year, up to 6,000 WhatsApp messages a year and 5 active workflows. Marketing Automation Suite is €199 a month with 2 seats and adds real-time visitor tracking, website personalisation, pop-ups, event tracking, a 360-degree contact view, advanced segmentation and AI agents, with 24,000 WhatsApp messages a year, 20 active workflows, 50 forms and 50 landing pages. Customer Engagement Platform is €499 a month with 2 seats and adds product recommendations, web push and the advanced data platform, with up to 120,000 WhatsApp messages a year, 100 workflows, 100 forms and 100 landing pages. Every plan includes up to 60,000 emails a year. Extra seats cost €69, €99 or €199 a seat a month billed annually, depending on the plan. Add-ons: Loyalty Program €199 a month, Sales €59, Customer Service €59 and Mobile App Marketing €59, all billed annually; on Campaigns, forms and landing pages were €29 a month each on 7 October (€49 each on 13 November). A separate Data & Activation Suite for teams of 10 or more users was not priced on the page on 7 October. The FAQ says monthly billing exists, but the page prints only annual prices; the free trial lasts 7 days with no card, auto-renewal is on by default, and cancelling stops the renewal without a refund. Re-read on 13 November 2026: the three Marketing Suite prices, included seats and extra-seat prices are unchanged. The page now gives the allowances per month, 5,000 emails on every Marketing Suite plan and 500, 2,000 or 10,000 WhatsApp messages, the same totals as the yearly figures above. Three things changed. Forms and landing pages on Campaigns now cost €49 a month each, and the Marketing Automation Suite lists a Website Experience add-on at €59 a month. The Data & Activation Suite now has a published plan: Performance at €999 a month billed annually with 10 seats (extra seats €199 a seat a month), up to 300,000 emails a month, up to 100,000 marketing contacts and 10,000 WhatsApp messages a month; Limitless, with unlimited seats and sending, is priced through sales. The same page also sells a Newsletter Suite of rapidmail plans: Essential €15 and Professional €25 a month, or €20 for a single pay-as-you-go send. The FAQ now says add-ons are billed per seat, and that switching off auto-renewal on a Data & Activation plan takes 90 days' notice before the annual renewal date. Read again on 18 November 2026 during our own test: the pricing page now has a Monthly toggle, showing €89, €239 and €599 a month for the three plans with 5,000 emails a month, and on Campaigns forms and landing pages were back at €29 a month each. Our trial account showed 'Emails left: 10' above the campaign list.

compare_with.name: Brevo
compare_with.why: Brevo is in our dossiers too and also combines email, SMS and WhatsApp for small businesses. Positive User puts the weight on behaviour: real-time visitor tracking, personalisation and workflows from the €199 plan, with unlimited contacts but a fixed 60,000 emails a year on every Marketing Suite plan. A team whose cost driver is sending volume should price both on its real yearly email count before choosing.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 18 November 2026 the session set up a trial of Positive User, imported 5 test contacts, saved a draft form and built the skeleton of a three-step e-mail series. The first import failed on all 5 lines because the company in the file did not exist yet; the second, without the company column, worked. The series (trigger Added to list, three e-mail steps) was saved as inactive, but the choice of campaign in each step stayed empty (No options available), so it is not ready to run, even though the home page says Your first automation is set. The campaigns use a shared sending domain, the trial lasts 7 days and shows Emails left: 10, and no card was asked. The pricing page now has a Monthly button next to Yearly: 89, 239 and 599 euro a month against 69, 199 and 499 euro billed yearly, with 5,000 e-mails a month included. Nothing was sent, bought or cancelled. Account and start: we created the account (a workspace on the trial, app.user.com); the sign-up wizard stood on Step 4 of 7 when our AI assistant took over at 18:24 (Amsterdam) and chose Less than 19, Software web & IT services, Less than 5K and Every day. Step 7 of 7 said: Today: Start exploring. No credit card required. You pay 0 euro. Day 7: We will remind you and help you setup your payment. The button Start trial now opened the workspace after about 25 seconds of loading. The interface was already in English. The cookie banner was answered with No, thanks. The dossier name is Positive User (earlier called User.com) and the review is on MSS (mss/positive-user-review.html). Audience: the request named Small marketing teams (pain: e-mail, forms and pop-ups sit in four tools that do not talk to each other). That is not a literal dossier group; the nearest dossier group is One-person teams sending email, SMS and WhatsApp, whose pain is that campaigns run on three separate tools. The test result for that group is partly. Import: Data, Contacts, Add contacts, Import contacts, with a test file of 5 contacts at example.com. Attempt 1 (18:26): Email matched and Company mapped to Company name; result Total rows 5, Succeeded 0, Failed 5, each line File import failed: Company with name Sample Snowboards does not exist (and the same for the other four), so companies must exist before they can be imported. First Name and Last Name could not be chosen as standard attributes (a search gave No results found) and stayed Not ready. Attempt 2 (18:27): only Email mapped; 5 of 5 imported, each contact shows its e-mail address as its name, and the counter shows 6 with the one contact the owner already had. Before the import a pop-up asks to confirm GDPR compliance and a lawful basis; the choice was Import (testdata). The switch Run your automations on imported data was off. Form: Website Experience, Forms, Create your first form (Takes about 10 minutes), name Test Newsletter Signup, the Positive User template Base form with the fields First name, Last name, Email, Phone number and Submit, a thanks message filled in, and Save (not Publish): The form content has been saved. It was not placed on a site. Series: Automations, Create your first automation. Blocks had to be dragged (clicking did not work): the trigger Added to list and three blocks Send an email campaign, each with the exits On Sent, On Open, On Click and Unsubscribe; the first and second and the second and third were joined through On Sent. Saved as Test 3-step email series with the status Inactive (the switch Run this automation - enable stayed off). The home page then said Your first automation is set and 2 of 6 done. Every step asks for a campaign (Campaign*, Select). New campaign opens a second tab (Email campaigns), template Yuzzu, a choice between One-time send and Automated send (Automated send chosen), the campaign Test Welcome 1 with the subject Welcome to our test list, duplicated twice into Test Follow-up 2 and Test Last Nudge 3. In the automation step the list stayed empty with the text No options available, also after saving and reloading; the reason was not found. The campaigns are drafts (orange dot, Type Automated, Scheduled for: -). The review screen offers Publish; it was not clicked to avoid any chance of sending. So the three steps have no linked e-mail and the series is only a skeleton, not ready to run. Time: start 18:24:01, last action 18:32:49, so about 9 minutes, but the series is ready only as a skeleton because the link from a step to a campaign did not work. Sending: the campaign shows Sending settings: Default system SMTP and the sender on a Shared domain of the platform, with the recommendation Send from your own domain (Add my domain). Not needed to build or save; not touched, since it would ask for DNS records. No test mail was sent. Plans up to the payment: Read by the tester on 18 Nov 2026 on user.com/pricing, Marketing Suite, in euro and excluding VAT. Yearly view: Campaigns 69 euro a month with 1 seat, Marketing Automation Suite 199 euro a month with 2 seats, Customer Engagement Platform 499 euro a month with 2 seats; extra seats 69, 99 and 199 euro a month when billed yearly; every plan says Up to 60,000 emails/year included; workflows 5, 20 and 100; forms 50 on the middle plan and 100 on the top plan; pop-ups, real time visitor tracking and website personalization start at the Marketing Automation Suite. Forms and landing pages on Campaigns cost 29 euro a month, billed yearly (the dossier said 49 on 13 November). Monthly view (new: the page now has a Monthly button next to Yearly, save up to 250 euro): 89, 239 and 599 euro a month with Up to 5,000 emails/month included, WhatsApp 500, 2,000 and 10,000 messages a month and workflows 5, 20 and 100. The dossier said that the page shows only yearly prices; that is no longer true, and the dossier was already corrected (SEO b0d0d97). FAQ: Do I need a credit card to sign up? No, all you need is an e-mail address. The trial lasts 7 days with the full feature set and all add-ons. Stopping the auto-renewal goes through the account manager, at least 30 days before the yearly renewal on the Marketing Suite (90 days on the Data & Activation Suite) or 3 business days before a monthly renewal; No refunds are issued. Inside the trial: Your plan trial ends in 7 days (button Upgrade, which opens user.com/pricing), Emails left: 10 above the campaign list, and the AI assistant Uma was switched off for the workspace. No payment screen and no card field was reached, so tax, fees and a total were not seen. Prices were not changed by this delivery. Cancelling: not tested, because there is no paid plan and the account stays. Not tested: building a pop-up, a landing page, SMS, WhatsApp, the tracking script, letting the series run, publishing a campaign, an own sending domain, and cancelling or deleting the account. Clean up (still so): the account, the workspace, the 5 test contacts, the draft form Test Newsletter Signup, the 3 draft campaigns and the inactive automation Test 3-step email series stay; nothing was sent or published and no script was placed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: A contact import fails when the file names a company that does not exist yet, and First Name and Last Name could not be chosen as standard attributes, so the contacts show their e-mail address as their name. Blocks in the automation builder have to be dragged; clicking does nothing. Each e-mail step needs an existing campaign, and the list of campaigns stayed empty, so the series could not be completed, while the home page says that the first automation is set. Campaigns start on a shared sending domain; an own domain is recommended and needs DNS records. The trial lasts 7 days and shows Emails left: 10.

The first import failed on all 5 lines because the company in the file did not exist yet; the second, without the company column, worked. Nothing was sent, bought or cancelled. Account and start: we created the account (a workspace on the trial, app.user.com); the sign-up wizard stood on Step 4 of 7 when our AI assistant took over at 18:24 (Amsterdam) and chose Less than 19, Software web & IT services, Less than 5K and Every day. Step 7 of 7 said: Today: Start exploring. No credit card required. You pay 0 euro. Day 7: We will remind you and help you setup your payment. The button Start trial now opened the workspace after about 25 seconds of loading. The interface was already in English. The cookie banner was answered with No, thanks. The dossier name is Positive User (earlier called User.com) and the review is on MSS (mss/positive-user-review.html). Audience: the request named Small marketing teams (pain: e-mail, forms and pop-ups sit in four tools that do not talk to each other). That is not a literal dossier group; the nearest dossier group is One-person teams sending email, SMS and WhatsApp, whose pain is that campaigns run on three separate tools. The test result for that group is partly. Import: Data, Contacts, Add contacts, Import contacts, with a test file of 5 contacts at example.com. Attempt 1 (18:26): Email matched and Company mapped to Company name; result Total rows 5, Succeeded 0, Failed 5, each line File import failed: Company with name Sample Snowboards does not exist (and the same for the other four), so companies must exist before they can be imported. First Name and Last Name could not be chosen as standard attributes (a search gave No results found) and stayed Not ready. Attempt 2 (18:27): only Email mapped; 5 of 5 imported, each contact shows its e-mail address as its name, and the counter shows 6 with the one contact the owner already had. Before the import a pop-up asks to confirm GDPR compliance and a lawful basis; the choice was Import (testdata). The switch Run your automations on imported data was off. Form: Website Experience, Forms, Create your first form (Takes about 10 minutes), name Test Newsletter Signup, the Positive User template Base form with the fields First name, Last name, Email, Phone number and Submit, a thanks message filled in, and Save (not Publish): The form content has been saved. It was not placed on a site. Series: Automations, Create your first automation. Blocks had to be dragged (clicking did not work): the trigger Added to list and three blocks Send an email campaign, each with the exits On Sent, On Open, On Click and Unsubscribe; the first and second and the second and third were joined through On Sent. Saved as Test 3-step email series with the status Inactive (the switch Run this automation - enable stayed off). The home page then said Your first automation is set and 2 of 6 done. Every step asks for a campaign (Campaign*, Select). New campaign opens a second tab (Email campaigns), template Yuzzu, a choice between One-time send and Automated send (Automated send chosen), the campaign Test Welcome 1 with the subject Welcome to our test list, duplicated twice into Test Follow-up 2 and Test Last Nudge 3. In the automation step the list stayed empty with the text No options available, also after saving and reloading; the reason was not found. The campaigns are drafts (orange dot, Type Automated, Scheduled for: -). The review screen offers Publish; it was not clicked to avoid any chance of sending. So the three steps have no linked e-mail and the series is only a skeleton, not ready to run. Time: start 18:24:01, last action 18:32:49, so about 9 minutes, but the series is ready only as a skeleton because the link from a step to a campaign did not work. Sending: the campaign shows Sending settings: Default system SMTP and the sender on a Shared domain of the platform, with the recommendation Send from your own domain (Add my domain). Not needed to build or save; not touched, since it would ask for DNS records. No test mail was sent. Plans up to the payment: Read by the tester on 18 Nov 2026 on user.com/pricing, Marketing Suite, in euro and excluding VAT. Yearly view: Campaigns 69 euro a month with 1 seat, Marketing Automation Suite 199 euro a month with 2 seats, Customer Engagement Platform 499 euro a month with 2 seats; extra seats 69, 99 and 199 euro a month when billed yearly; every plan says Up to 60,000 emails/year included; workflows 5, 20 and 100; forms 50 on the middle plan and 100 on the top plan; pop-ups, real time visitor tracking and website personalization start at the Marketing Automation Suite. Forms and landing pages on Campaigns cost 29 euro a month, billed yearly (the dossier said 49 on 13 November). Monthly view (new: the page now has a Monthly button next to Yearly, save up to 250 euro): 89, 239 and 599 euro a month with Up to 5,000 emails/month included, WhatsApp 500, 2,000 and 10,000 messages a month and workflows 5, 20 and 100. The dossier said that the page shows only yearly prices; that is no longer true, and the dossier was already corrected (SEO b0d0d97). FAQ: Do I need a credit card to sign up? No, all you need is an e-mail address. The trial lasts 7 days with the full feature set and all add-ons. Stopping the auto-renewal goes through the account manager, at least 30 days before the yearly renewal on the Marketing Suite (90 days on the Data & Activation Suite) or 3 business days before a monthly renewal; No refunds are issued. Inside the trial: Your plan trial ends in 7 days (button Upgrade, which opens user.com/pricing), Emails left: 10 above the campaign list, and the AI assistant Uma was switched off for the workspace. No payment screen and no card field was reached, so tax, fees and a total were not seen. Prices were not changed by this delivery. Cancelling: not tested, because there is no paid plan and the account stays. Not tested: building a pop-up, a landing page, SMS, WhatsApp, the tracking script, letting the series run, publishing a campaign, an own sending domain, and cancelling or deleting the account. Clean up (still so): the account, the workspace, the 5 test contacts, the draft form Test Newsletter Signup, the 3 draft campaigns and the inactive automation Test 3-step email series stay; nothing was sent or published and no script was placed. No kit records were entered. A check of this export route with synthetic records, on the account and date stated. Re-importing the export was not tested. The exported file was not opened, so what it contains is unverified. Friction is described, not scored; this is not a verdict on the product.

findings: Text we checked: "No credit card required. You pay 0€". What we saw: The sign-up wizard says this on its last step, the FAQ says that only an e-mail address is needed, and no card field was seen anywhere, also not behind the Upgrade button, which opens the pricing page.

Text we checked: "Campaigns €69/month (1 seat)". What we saw: The yearly view of the pricing page shows Campaigns at 69 euro, Marketing Automation Suite at 199 euro with 2 seats and Customer Engagement Platform at 499 euro with 2 seats, as in the dossier.

Text we checked: "Up to 5,000 emails/month included". What we saw: The page now has a Monthly button next to Yearly, which shows 89, 239 and 599 euro a month with 5,000 e-mails a month included. Until 13 November the dossier said that the page printed only yearly prices.
Text we checked: "€29/month (billed yearly)". What we saw: On the yearly view, forms and landing pages on Campaigns cost 29 euro a month, billed yearly. The dossier gave 49 euro on 13 November.

claim_checks.claim: One-person teams sending email, SMS and WhatsApp
claim_checks.observed: Contacts, a form and a series skeleton with three e-mail steps were built in one app, but the steps have no linked e-mail, and SMS and WhatsApp were not tried, so the dossier group outcome of partly is the most the test shows.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The dossier audience against a skeleton series that was never switched on; SMS and WhatsApp were not tried.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The one-tool promise holds for contacts, forms and the series editor, but a working three-step series was not reached, so check the campaign link yourself in the trial.

claim_checks.claim: No credit card required. You pay 0€
claim_checks.observed: The sign-up wizard says this on its last step, the FAQ says that only an e-mail address is needed, and no card field was seen anywhere, also not behind the Upgrade button, which opens the pricing page.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The wizard text, the FAQ and our own path through the trial; no payment screen was reached.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: You can try the product for 7 days without handing over a card.

claim_checks.claim: Your plan trial ends in 7 days.
claim_checks.observed: The banner in the app shows 7 days left on the first day and the wizard says that on Day 7 the account will be reminded to set up payment.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The banner and the wizard text against the dossier trial length; nothing was extended.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The trial is short for an automation tool, so prepare a contact file and a real campaign before you start the clock.

claim_checks.observed: The yearly view of the pricing page says Up to 60,000 emails/year included on every plan, and the monthly view says Up to 5,000 emails/month included. Inside the trial the app shows Emails left: 10 above the campaign list.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: A trial counter against the allowance of a paid plan; the two are different limits and no paid plan was used.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The paid allowance and the trial allowance differ a lot, so the 10 e-mails of the trial do not show how a paid plan behaves.

claim_checks.observed: The yearly view of the pricing page shows Campaigns at 69 euro, Marketing Automation Suite at 199 euro with 2 seats and Customer Engagement Platform at 499 euro with 2 seats, as in the dossier.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The yearly view of the pricing page against the dossier prices; the currency is euro on both and VAT is excluded.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The yearly prices are the same as in the dossier.

claim_checks.observed: The page now has a Monthly button next to Yearly, which shows 89, 239 and 599 euro a month with 5,000 e-mails a month included. Until 13 November the dossier said that the page printed only yearly prices.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The monthly view of the pricing page against the earlier dossier statement that only yearly prices are printed.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: Monthly billing now has a printed price, but it is higher per month than the yearly price on every plan.

claim_checks.observed: The label sits next to the Monthly button. The monthly prices are higher than the yearly ones on all three plans, but the page does not say over which period the 250 euro saving is counted, so it could not be checked.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The label against the prices of the two views; the period of the saving is not printed.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The saving claim cannot be read against the printed prices, so work it out for your own plan before choosing monthly or yearly.

claim_checks.observed: On the yearly view, forms and landing pages on Campaigns cost 29 euro a month, billed yearly. The dossier gave 49 euro on 13 November.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The add-on price on the pricing page against the dossier price of 13 November.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The add-on price on the entry plan went back down to 29 euro, so check the price on the day you buy.

claim_checks.claim: For 7 days ... full feature set and all add-ons
claim_checks.observed: The FAQ promises the full feature set for 7 days. In the trial the AI assistant Uma was switched off for the workspace and the e-mail counter said Emails left: 10; the other features were not all opened, because nothing was published or sent.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The FAQ line against what the trial showed; most features were not tried.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The trial may have more limits than the FAQ line suggests, and you only find out when you publish or send.

claim_checks.observed: The first form screen says it takes about 10 minutes. The form was named, built on the Base form template and saved as a draft, but the time of this step was not measured on its own.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: Our own clock covered the whole session (about 9 minutes from the start) and not this step.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: A basic form can be saved quickly; how long a finished and published form takes was not measured.

claim_checks.claim: File import failed: Company with name Sample Snowboards does not exist
claim_checks.observed: The first import with the company column mapped failed for 5 of 5 lines with this error; the second import without that column worked for 5 of 5. First Name and Last Name could not be chosen as attributes.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: Our own two import attempts with the same test file; the dossier does not describe the import.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: Import contacts without companies, or create the companies first, and expect the contacts to show their e-mail address as their name.

claim_checks.observed: The home page says this after the series was saved, but the series is inactive, and in each of the three steps the choice of campaign stayed empty with No options available, also after saving and reloading.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The home page message against the saved series and the empty campaign choice.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The home page says that the first automation is set, while the series cannot run yet, so do not trust that message.

claim_checks.observed: The review screen of the campaign shows the sender on a Shared domain of the platform and recommends sending from your own domain; the button Add my domain was not clicked, because it would ask for DNS records. No test mail was sent.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The review screen of the campaign; no mail was sent and no domain was added.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: You can start sending from a shared domain, but the platform itself recommends your own domain for inbox placement.

claim_checks.observed: The FAQ says that no refunds are issued, and that stopping the auto-renewal takes notice of at least 30 days before a yearly renewal on the Marketing Suite. Cancelling was not tested, because there is no paid plan.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The FAQ text against a test that bought and cancelled nothing.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: A yearly plan renews by default and the notice period is long, so put the date in your calendar.

claim_checks.observed: The pricing page was read on both views, yearly and monthly, but no checkout, tax or total was reached, because the trial needs no card and the Upgrade button leads to the pricing page.
claim_checks.plan: Trial account; 5 test contacts were imported (the first attempt failed on the company column), a draft form and an inactive three-step series without linked campaigns were made, and the plans were read on the public pricing page; nothing was bought or sent
claim_checks.comparability: The printed page prices against a checkout that was never reached; no stored cost rule or fee line could be compared.
claim_checks.buying_consequence: The amount you pay including VAT and fees was not seen, so only the printed prices are known.
